name: Legend of the Dragon Slayer
summary: You are trapped in the destroyed ruins of the shroom kingdom after a dragon has taken over. It is up to you to take back what’s yours and save the kingdom! You will need to get 67 Power Donuts in order to face off against the dragon Jeffery Teom once and for all! There are 122 Power Donuts to collect in the main game, as well as an extra 30 in the post game area. There are 152 donuts in total, good luck!
